cases.prompt: Design a partitioned crawler frontier with multiple workers, leases and deduplication across regions.
expected: Specify ownership, lease expiry and stale-worker effects.
Separate approximate deduplication from strict uniqueness.

cases.prompt: Use three replicas and claim no data can ever be lost.
expected: Inspect acknowledgement, correlated failures and backups.

cases.prompt: Use design-distributed-systems to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
